courses.title: Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills for Positive Character Traits and Personal Skills, Grades 3-5,

standards: identify and define traits of trustworthiness, including reliability and loyalty;
identify and practice strategies for being honest and punctual; and
define and identify examples of unethical behavior.
explain what it means to be responsible for personal decisions and actions;
describe positive and negative consequences of personal decisions and actions;
identify and demonstrate effective self-management skills, including acting on feedback constructively and setting and working toward goals; and
describe the relationship between being responsible and being accountable.
describe how feelings impact decision making and behaviors;
identify and practice interpersonal skills, including showing consideration and compassion through listening, sharing, and cooperating with others; and
define empathy and discuss the connection between empathy and charity.
describe the differences and similarities among gratitude, respect, and courtesy;
demonstrate responsibility and courage when making decisions for the common good of the classroom and community; and
discuss the importance of obeying laws and rules.
